title: Brother Victor pushed down an elevator shaft
place_text: Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia, Park Avenue and 93rd Street, Manhattan

tellings.quote: in which case they pushed him down an elevator shaft and broke his legs.

plain: A writer named Peter Levenda tells of a man he knew as Brother Victor, connected to a branch of the Russian Orthodox Church based outside Russia, at its church on Park Avenue and 93rd Street in Manhattan, around 1968. Levenda says that someone pushed Brother Victor down an elevator shaft and broke his legs. He tells it as a sign of how dangerous the hidden world he was moving in could be.
